summary: Titus voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement, and holds campaign-claimed endorsements from the Democratic Majority for Israel PAC and the Jewish Democratic Council of America. She did vote against the 2023 Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act and co-led a letter to protect humanitarian aid delivery to Gaza, but her IHRA vote and pro-Israel Democratic endorsements place her in the Israel-centric framing the grade reflects.
